GEN-IDENTITY.contract: Scient Agent and a stock omp never read, write or steer each other's state: state folders, variables, pipes and socket folders carry Scient's names. Regenerated at every alignment.

GEN-WORDING.contract: The agent calls itself Scient Agent wherever a person or a model reads its words. Regenerated at every alignment.

SA-PRODUCT.contract: scient.json names the product, its version and the exact Oh My Pi release it derives from; --version and --runtime-info report them.

SA-ROOT.contract: A host-assigned root (SCIENT_AGENT_ROOT, from the launch environment only) holds all of the agent's state.

SA-NATIVE-CACHE.contract: A compiled binary extracts its addon into a directory named for the addon's content and loads only that addon.

SA-AUTH.contract: A host sees each sign-in's kind, whether it is stored and the store it shares; sign-out over RPC removes it or fails; a broker's sign-ins stay with the broker; a sign-in completed in another process reaches a running session.

SA-BRAND.contract: Pages the agent shows a person (the sign-in result page, the stats dashboard) carry Scient Agent's symbol and colors.

SA-RELEASE.contract: Only Scient's own workflow builds, signs and drafts releases; Oh My Pi's publishing and repository automation is removed.
